description: A parsed EOT keeps the channel busy past the burst end; csma.vdcd_end runs to the predicted end, and that VDCD-determined idle gives LBT_WAIT_TIMER lbt_wait_vdcd_ms (LBT rule 3).
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". The D_PDU (C_PDU ID 1) is from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9, another node, with EOT 10: end time 2000 + 10 x 500 = 7000 (C-1024). The burst ends at 6000 with the prediction still in the future, so the channel stays busy and csma.vdcd_end runs 1000 ms (K-0111). At 7000 VDCD clears last, so rule 3 gives 3000 ms (K-0071, K-0073). The first contention draw of seed 0 is uniform(16) = 15, so 45000 ms (prng.md 5). Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
